components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold-filled CTA. Used for music and main actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C9A855; color: #060406; padding: 14px 40px; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.3s; display: inline-block; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E8D080; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(201,168,85,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A855; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent with cream border. Used as secondary action beside Primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgba(245,237,216,0.6); padding: 13px 40px; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid rgba(245,237,216,0.3); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.3s, color 0.3s; display: inline-block; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #F5EDD8; color: #F5EDD8; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(245,237,216,0.5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Fan CTA
components.description: Scarlet Rose filled. The one conversion button. Shimmer on hover, permanent ambient glow in bio.
components.html: ✦ For the Real Fans →
components.css: .ds-btn-fan { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #E91E8C; color: #fff; padding: 17px 22px; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 3px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 28px rgba(233,30,140,0.45), 0 0 60px rgba(233,30,140,0.18); transition: box-shadow 0.3s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-fan::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -60%; width: 40%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.18), transparent); animation: ds-shimmer 3.5s ease 1.2s infinite; } .ds-btn-fan:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 70px rgba(233,30,140,0.55); transform: translateY(-2px); } @keyframes ds-shimmer { 0% { left: -60%; } 100% { left: 120%; } } .ds-btn-fan:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav CTA
components.description: Scarlet Rose ghost button in navigation. Fills solid on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { padding: 8px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(233,30,140,0.5); color: #E91E8C; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; transition: background 0.3s, color 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #E91E8C; color: #fff; border-color: #E91E8C; } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E91E8C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Link Card
components.description: Social platform row with icon, label, handle, and animated gold fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; padding: 20px 28px; background: #150F15; border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,85,0.09); text-decoration: none; color: #F5EDD8; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-link-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(201,168,85,0.12); transform: translateX(-105%); transition: transform 0.45s ease; } .ds-link-card:hover { border-color: rgba(201,168,85,0.4); transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-link-card:hover::before { transform: translateX(0); } .ds-link-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: rgba(245,237,216,0.6); flex-shrink: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; transition: color 0.3s; } .ds-link-card:hover .ds-link-icon { color: #C9A855; } .ds-link-text { flex: 1; position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-link-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #F5EDD8; } .ds-link-handle { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(245,237,216,0.3); } .ds-link-arrow { font-size: 18px; color: #C9A855; position: relative; z-index: 1; opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px); transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.3s; } .ds-link-card:hover .ds-link-arrow { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } .ds-link-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9A855; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Genre Tag
components.description: Decorative pill label for genre and category indicators.
components.css: .ds-genre-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Josefin Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 7px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(201,168,85,0.3); color: #C9A855; border-radius: 50px; transition: background 0.3s, border-color 0.3s; } .ds-genre-tag:hover { background: rgba(201,168,85,0.12); border-color: #C9A855; }

narrative.overview:
This is a surface built for the 10-second glance from a phone screen at midnight. A fan taps from an Instagram story into a world that feels like arriving at a private event — dark and quiet, something gold catching the light, the energy of something expensive and slightly dangerous.

The system uses four dark stops (#060406 through #1C141C) to create depth through tonal layering, not shadow. Gold carries authority; scarlet-rose carries urgency. Everything else is near-black. The design doesn't try to be Latin — it IS Latin in the way YSL is French: through precision, attitude, and the refusal to explain itself.

All copy is minimal. Labels are uppercase, tracked out, impossibly small. Headings are large to the point of risk. The space between them is the content.
keyCharacteristics: Four-stop tonal dark system instead of flat black
Gold accent at ≤15% saturation on any surface; scarlet-rose for primary CTAs only
Cinzel Decorative for display and section headlines; Josefin Sans for body and labels
Sharp corners everywhere (radius: 0) except pill tags (50px) and circular avatars
Film grain at 4% opacity: always present, never noticed
No hover interactions on touch; full JS cursor on desktop

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Scarlet Rose is used in ≤3 places per screen. A fourth use kills the urgency.

rules.name: The Anti-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Gold means antique warmth. Never #FFD700 or chrome gold.

rules.name: The Scale Cliff Rule
rules.body: The jump between type steps must remain abrupt. No intermediate sizes.

rules.name: The Uppercase Ceiling
rules.body: Uppercase with tracking is for labels only (≤11px). Never above 14px.

rules.name: The At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow responds to state only. The fan CTA bio glow is the one earned exception.

rules.name: The Whole-Card-is-a-Link Rule
rules.body: Song cards are <a> tags. Platform icons inside are <span>. One tap target per card.

dos: Do keep Scarlet Rose in ≤3 places per screen.
Do use the tonal layering system (Void → Nocturne → Velvet → Onyx) for depth.
Do make every song card and link card a single <a> tag.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: wrap all entrance animations.
Do load retargeting pixels before any other script.
Do keep label type at 9–11px uppercase with 0.22em–0.55em letter-spacing.
Do use Parchment (#F5EDD8) for all foreground text — never pure white.
Do keep touch targets at 44×44px minimum.
donts: Don't use neon-on-black, graffiti fonts, or SoundCloud-rapper aesthetics.
Don't use the generic music-artist major-label layout on white.
Don't make the bio page look like Linktree.
Don't use tropical signifiers (bright reds, oranges, flag imagery, folkloric patterns).
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient background).
Don't add a fourth dark stop below Onyx or above Void.
Don't add looping decorative animations beyond grain, ticker, and scroll-indicator.
Don't use pure white (#fff) anywhere — Parchment (#F5EDD8) is the ceiling.
Don't use border-left as a colored accent stripe on any card or callout.
